name: Summon Fiend

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see within range

upcast.text: Use the slot level in the stat block: higher slots give the spirit more Hit Points, AC and damage.

summary: Call a fiendish spirit, a Demon, Devil or Yugoloth, to fight beside you.
text: It uses the Fiendish Spirit stat block, shares your Initiative and takes its turn right after yours, obeying your commands. Its stats grow with the slot level.
